Name: Pramāṇalakṣaṇa
Detail: Kept together on the shared title: nothing on the romanized page points to a different work, but it is not confirmed as Madhva's.

Name: Praśnottararatnamālikā

Name: Sāmavedaprātiśākhya

Name: Śaṅkaravijaya
Detail: Kept apart from the Śaṅkaradigvijaya: several Śaṅkaravijayas exist and this one is not identified.

Name: Sāramañjarī

Name: Siddhāntadarpaṇa

Name: Śivastuti

Name: Sphuṭārthā

Name: Amarakavi

Name: Brahmānanda

Name: Gauḍapāda

Name: Gautama

Name: Jaimini

Name: Nandikeśvara
